# Convert String to Uppercase

#### Course: Learn C++ Basics

## Convert String to Uppercase

We know that the toupper() function converts a character to uppercase. In this example, we will use these functions to convert an entire string to uppercase.

### Thought Process

We can't directly use the toupper() function to convert a string since it only converts a single character to uppercase.

So, we need to access each character of the string and convert it to uppercase. To do this, we will be using a for loop. Each iteration of the loop will change each string character to uppercase.

### Source Code

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2#include <cctype>
3using namespace std;
4
5int main() {
6
7    string text;
8
9    cout << "Enter a string: ";
10    getline(cin, text);
11
12    // convert to uppercase
13    for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); ++i) {
14        text[i] = toupper(text[i]);
15    }
16
17    cout << "Uppercase = " << text << endl;
18
19    return 0;
20}
```

Output

```text
Enter a string: Iron Maiden!
Uppercase = IRON MAIDEN!
```
